name: Haian Rubber Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Haian Rubber Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and operation management of mining tires in China and internationally. The company offers off-the-road (OTR) tires, mining dump truck tires, giant earthmover tires, specialty earthmover tires, rigid dump truck tires, mining OTR tires, earthmover mining tires, and radial OTR tires. It also engages in civil engineering construction activities. The company exports its products. Haian Rubber Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Putian, China.
